field_edits.updated_text: Mild lumbar levoconvex curvature. Normal density and alignment. Vertebral body heights are maintained without acute compression deformity or focal destructive osseous lesion. No acute fracture is seen.
Mild multilevel degenerative disc space narrowing and endplate osteophyte formation, greatest at L4-L5 and L5-S1. The remaining disc spaces are preserved.

The sacroiliac joints are maintained.
No acute osseous abnormality is identified.

impression:
1. Multilevel lumbar spondylosis/degenerative disc disease, greatest at L4-L5 and L5-S1.
2. Lower lumbar facet arthropathy.
3. Mild lumbar levoconvex curvature.
4. No acute osseous abnormality.
